data.body: Contract clarification from Epic A0 (188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c — namespaced array stack detection): a topic-prompt loads when its identifier appears in the stack array (or matches a documented sub-prefix). This is a clarification to the prompts/<topic>.md mechanism's load-trigger semantics; no code change to 136b-6758 required. Documented in A0's DETECTION-SCHEMA.md.
